label: ETV6::NTRK3

sections.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
NTRK3 encodes TRKC, the neurotrophin-3 receptor tyrosine kinase.

The fusion joins the ETV6 oligomerization domain to the NTRK3 kinase domain, generating a transforming kinase. It is characteristic of infantile fibrosarcoma and secretory carcinomas and also occurs in cellular congenital mesoblastic nephroma.

Larotrectinib targets oncogenic NTRK-fusion-positive advanced solid tumors in adults and children without known acquired TRK resistance mutations, after progression or without satisfactory alternatives, when disease is metastatic or surgery would cause severe morbidity.
